 Talk Timer for Conference Speakers
 Conference organizers know the pain of speakers running over time. EventTimer's presentation timer puts a large, unambiguous countdown in the speaker's line of sight, on a confidence monitor, a tablet at the podium, or a screen at the back of the room. The countdown turns yellow at the 1-minute mark and red at 30 seconds, giving the speaker clear visual cues to wrap up without anyone having to wave a card or send a text. Pair it with the remote control feature and your stage manager can start, pause, or add time from backstage.
 Color-coded wrap-up warnings
 Remote control from backstage
 Confidence-monitor friendly
 No sound disruptions during talks

 Silent Timer for Meetings & Boardrooms
 In a boardroom, a beeping timer is the last thing you want. EventTimer runs silently by default. No sounds, no vibrations, just a clean visual countdown that keeps the meeting moving. Set a 5-minute timer for each agenda item, a 1-minute timer for lightning updates, or a 30-minute timer for the entire meeting. Everyone can see the time, everyone stays focused, and meetings actually end when they're supposed to. Use the multi-timer feature in Event Manager to pre-program the entire agenda.
 Silent by default. No disruptions

 Speaker Timer Display for Schools & Training
 Student presentations, debate rounds, teacher training sessions, any scenario where multiple people present in sequence benefits from a visible timer display. Set the allotted time, start the countdown when the speaker begins, and reset between presenters. The display is large enough for the audience to follow along, which creates shared accountability and helps nervous speakers pace themselves. Teachers report that visible timers reduce presentation anxiety because students can see exactly how much time they have left.
 Quick reset between speakers
 Audience-visible display
 Reduces speaker anxiety

 Get started
 Three steps, no signup

 1 Open the timer
 Visit eventtimer.io. The timer loads instantly in your browser, on any device.

 2 Set your duration
 Type any duration or choose a preset. Switch between countdown, count-up, or clock mode.

 3 Go fullscreen and start
 Press F for fullscreen, Space to start. Share the link if your team needs to see it.

 Common questions

 Can the speaker see the timer without the audience seeing controls?

 Yes. Use the shared timer feature. The speaker sees the fullscreen countdown (viewer link) while you control it from a separate device (controller link). The audience sees only the clean display.

 Is there a way to add extra time during a talk?

 Yes. From the controller screen you can pause the timer, adjust the remaining time, and resume. The speaker's display updates instantly.

 Can I pre-set timers for multiple speakers?

 Yes. Use the Event Manager to create a timer for each speaker with their allotted time. Switch between them as each talk begins.

 Does the timer make any sound?

 Sounds are off by default for a distraction-free experience. You can optionally enable a chime or alert sound when time is up.

 What size screen do I need?

 Any size works. The digits auto-scale to fill the available space. Even a tablet at the podium provides a clearly readable countdown for the speaker.
